label: Tunable basic unit (TBU) of a non-uniform hexagonal mesh: balanced MZI, two 50:50 MMIs, suspended-waveguide TiN heater in each arm, 900 um side
core_material: Si 220 nm SOI device layer; 500 nm single-mode waveguides, 193 nm DUV lithography
notes: Unit cell of the fabricated non-uniform programmable hexagonal waveguide mesh: 21 TBUs in a flattened four-cell hexagonal layout, two cells split by an internal TBU into defect cells (one hexagon into two 4-MZI cells, one into 3- and 5-MZI cells), 24 edge couplers with alignment loops, 42 DC channels wire-bonded to a PCB, chip 2.8 x 4.3 mm2 incl. pads and edge couplers (p.5, p.10; Fig. 3(b) labels 3.9 mm x 2.1 mm for the imaged area). No separate mesh row: the paper prints no mesh-level performance value (geometry-only, rule 9); the circuits programmed on it are the three Vernier rows. TBUs not perfectly balanced (fabrication deviations); each TBU calibrated with a polynomial theta(I) fit (p.6, Supp. Note 4). Class switch_fabric.mzi_mesh (D158: a cell characterized as part of a mesh): both performance values come from TBUs inside the fabricated mesh (0.48 dB 'per MZI' of the mesh rings, p.7 / p.10; Supp. Fig. 16 MZI 'PUC 21 - PS 34' characterized in place, p.21-23), not from a stand-alone test cell (the catalalahoz2026 nv_puc row, switch_fabric.other, is a separate test structure; ribeiro2016 mzi_cell precedent). MMI and heater are rows cmp_lit_catalalahoz2026a_mmi and cmp_lit_catalalahoz2026a_heater_ps. Fab: 'fabricated by Advanced Micro Foundry using a standard silicon on insulator process' (p.10 Sec. 6.1; also p.5 'silicon on insulator platform from Advanced Micro Foundry') -> org_amf; process_name empty (no named PDK or node, printed wording only). No facility acknowledged. Same group as lit:catalalahoz2026 (non-volatile Si-BTO FPPGA, CEA-Leti / Lumiphase chip); this paper's chip is a different, AMF-fabricated thermo-optic SOI mesh, so no component or value is shared with the 11 merged catalalahoz2026 rows. Not entered: ~0.08 dB per TBU and ~100 um TBU projections (cited refs. 45, 46, p.10).

core_material: LiNbO3 x-cut 500 nm on buried SiO2 on 500 um Si (NANOLN 4-inch LNOI); PLACE (fs-laser Cr mask writing + chemo-mechanical polish)
notes: MZIs of the 4x4 mesh: 3 directional couplers + 3 phase shifters ('perfect MZI', Miller); generator / analyzer MZIs: 4 DCs + 4 phase shifters (p.5, Supp. p.20-21). Fab: 'Our device is fabricated using a home-developed technology' (PLACE, p.19 Supp.) is an own-process statement (D84a), but the authors sit at ECNU and SIOM (and other centers), so the fabricating org is not unambiguous: fab empty (D80b / D154); NANOLN supplied the LNOI wafer (note only). process_name 'PLACE' as printed (no foundry).
